proposal.headline: Restrict the oversized Madison core by lowering the basal contacts
proposal.observation: In the northwestern half of the fold belt, the prediction exposes a broad, continuous purple Madison ribbon, whereas the observed Madison exposures are much narrower and interrupted by unobserved gaps. The surrounding older-unit belt is present in both maps, so this discrepancy does not by itself require another fold.
proposal.expected_effect: Shrink Madison exposure along the northwestern axial ridge and replace its margins mainly with Tensleep and a narrow Amsden band, while leaving the outer Triassic and Jurassic contacts unchanged.
